# has gender identity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasGenderIdentity`](gmeow-hasGenderIdentity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasGenderIdentity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gender`](../../slices/gender.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a person to a self-asserted gender-identity facet they hold. Non-functional and contextual — a person bears many co-equal identities; a superseded one is kept with [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false, never deleted. MUST NOT be inferred from [`gmeow:hasPronounSet`](gmeow-hasPronounSet.md), [`gmeow:honorific`](gmeow-honorific.md), [`gmeow:hasGenderExpression`](gmeow-hasGenderExpression.md) or [`gmeow:sexAssignedAtBirth`](gmeow-sexAssignedAtBirth.md).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link a person to each gender-identity facet they hold; assert it once per co-equal identity, leaving it non-functional so multiple facets coexist.

### Avoid when

- Avoid inferring it from pronouns, honorifics, gender expression, or sex-assigned-at-birth — there is deliberately no bridge — and avoid using it as a single privileged-gender selector (this is a co-equal facet axis, [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Point the person at a [`gmeow:GenderIdentity`](../classes/gmeow-GenderIdentity.md) facet whose [`gmeow:genderValue`](gmeow-genderValue.md) carries the value; for a superseded identity keep the facet and set [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false rather than retracting the triple.
